about.title: A developer who also runs a business
about.body1: I’m Faiz, based in Palembang. I started building websites for clients in 2022, and in my second semester at Politeknik Negeri Sriwijaya I reached the national final of KMIPN.
about.body2: Since then I have taught web app development, mentored junior students three years in a row, and in 2025 founded Berkala Digital, a digital agency in Palembang where I lead the creative and IT teams. Since June 2026 I have also worked as a software developer at Loranet Technologies PLT, a technology company in Malaysia.
about.body3: Running a business taught me something I bring to every project: an app is only finished when the people using it trust it.

contact.title: Got work that needs tidying up? Tell me about it.
contact.body: Plain words are fine, no technical terms needed. These three things help me understand it faster.
contact.prompt1: What runs today, whether that is spreadsheets, paper, group chats or another app.
contact.prompt3: Which part goes wrong most often, or is slowest.
contact.waMessage: Hi Faiz, I would like to ask about an app for my business.
contact.similarBody: Tell me about it on WhatsApp or by email, no technical language needed.
contact.signoff: Looking forward to hearing from you. — Faiz
